title: Precision on Demand: Escalating Weight Bits at Uncertain Decoding Steps in a Small Local Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.14418v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Local decoding usually fixes one weight precision for the whole generation. We study a different allocation: store 8-bit weights, decode with their top 4 bits, and redo a step at 8 bits only when the low-precision output distribution looks uncertain (entropy above a threshold or a small top-two margin). Quantization is simulated, the model is Qwen3-0.6B, and the benchmark is GSM8K. Cost is counted in weight bytes read per token. On 36724 replayed steps the entropy of the low pass ranks argmax flips with AUC 0.93. At a 15% escalation budget it catches 78% of flips and the margin gate 94%, against the 15% expected for a random gate of equal rate (a computed expectation, not a run). In 150 live problems all-high scores 64.0% and all-low 55.3% (McNemar p=0.053). An entropy gate with a 16% escalation rate scores 62.7% at 0.87 of the all-high weight bytes. Its paired difference is -1.3 (-8.0 to +5.3) points to all-high and +7.3 (+0.0 to +14.7)

translated_title: 按需精度：在小型本地模型的不确定解码步骤中动态提升权重位宽
translated_abstract: 本地解码通常在整个生成过程中固定使用单一权重精度。我们研究了一种不同的分配方式：存储8位权重，平时仅用其高4位进行解码，仅当低精度输出分布看起来不确定时（熵超过阈值或前两名概率差距过小），才用完整8位权重重新执行该步骤。量化采用模拟方式，模型为Qwen3-0.6B，基准测试为GSM8K，成本按每个token读取的权重字节数计算。在36724个重放步骤上，低精度通道的熵对argmax翻转具有0.93的AUC判别排序能力。在15%的升级预算下，熵门控可捕获78%的翻转，间距门控可捕获94%，而同等升级率的随机门控预期仅能捕获15%（该值为计算得到的期望，并非实际运行结果）。在150个实际问题中，全高精度得分为64.0%，全低精度为55.3%（McNemar p=0.053）。一个升级率为16%的熵门控在仅消耗全高精度0.87倍权重字节的情况下得分62.7%。其配对差异相对全高精度为-1.3分（-8.0至+5.3），相对全低精度为+7.3分（+0.0至+14.7）。
tldr: 提出按需精度的解码方法：小型本地模型平时用高4位权重解码，仅在输出分布不确定（高熵或前两名差距小）时升级到8位重算该步骤，以约87%的权重读取开销取得接近全高精度的准确率。
en_tdlr: Proposes precision-on-demand decoding: a small local model decodes with 4-bit weights by default and escalates to 8-bit recomputation only at uncertain steps, achieving near-full-precision accuracy at about 87% of the weight bytes read.
